operators.name: relu_cumsum_forward
semantics: Computes relu(x) elementwise, then cumulative sum along dim=1 on the relu result.
Output shape is identical to input (512, 512, 32, 32).
The cumsum is inclusive and preserves tensor strides as returned by torch.cumsum.
Elementwise relu on input tensor x of shape (512, 512, 32, 32).
Cumulative sum of the relu output along dimension 1 (channels), producing shape (512, 512, 32, 32).
